motions.topic: STRUCTURE PREDICTION RUNG: install and validate ESMFold (lighter than AlphaFold, ~3 GB model) to cross the sequence->3D boundary for SPECIFICITY. The validation is the first deliverable, not design: predict the structure of a KNOWN antibody-antigen complex (pdb_00009pzi_F_E), measure RMSD against its crystal, and report whether the predictor is usable before any design is attempted. REJECT AS PREMATURE: attempting design before the RMSD validation; claiming specificity from a predictor whose RMSD is not measured against a crystal. MEASURED: the paratope is promiscuous (cognate z=-2.5 sigma vs rotation-optimized random antigens); the sequence->density model predicts stickiness (36% better than mean, precision@77 45.5%), not specificity. Crossing the specificity boundary needs structure prediction against a real antigen, none of which is in-tree.
